reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.shared_object: A formal evidence item considered for a named assurance or reusable-component role, and the separate scientific claim supported by that item. The examined examples are FAA AC20-115D(21July2017) recognition of DO333(13December2011) and AC20-148(7December2004) reusable-component evidence. No target is declared subject to either guidance.
common.source_fact_scope: The public guidance is a recognized optional means within its stated aviation domain. The2017 text recognizes the supplement within an assurance process. The2004 text distinguishes component acceptance, bounded reuse, integration and changed-component acceptance. Paid DO333 clauses were not read or used to claim compliance.
common.scientific_distinction: Recognition/credit and the truth of a mathematical or operational claim are different variables. A formal result can remain valid while its recognized reuse status changes. A recognition record can be useful evidence of a permitted role without proving the theorem or wider system function.
common.guard: The actual decision concerns this evidence item within the named framework and its declared domain/edition/role. Establish which objective, component, configuration and assumptions the item addresses. If no such consumer exists, ordinary review/replay can be enough; do not manufacture certification paperwork.
common.contrary_control: AC20-148 permits unchanged reuse within its accepted limitations, so a blanket repeat-everything rule is wrong. Its changed-component rule distinguishes recognized status from scientific truth: an independently proved semantic equivalence would not itself rewrite the acceptance letter. Conversely, a letter does not derive the software theorem.
common.effect_authority_boundary: These are source-based distinctions about evidence use, not a finding of current compliance, safety, adoption, target applicability or permission to change a real control.
common.cost_alternative: Retain inexpensive unchanged evidence where adequate. Count qualification, communication and upkeep only for an actual framework consumer. A short impact note, ordinary theorem replay or dormant archive can remain the proportionate engineering option outside a required submission role.
common.reentry: Changed framework/edition, actual submission purpose, recognized configuration or usage domain, scientific premise, retained consumer or contrary source changes reopen the corresponding direction.
common.evidence_ceiling: Own selected public-guidance reading and qualified F041/native member meanings. No certification project, paid-standard inspection, regulatory determination, measured comparative benefit or independent validation.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Retirement of an active formal-evidence/control item while preserving actual residual consumers.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The named framework can supply a real remaining evidence consumer even when runtime callers are absent. That distinguishes a removable duplicate execution from an evidence item still needed for accepted reuse; the mathematical result can be archived without being declared false.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Retirement of an active formal-evidence/control item while preserving actual residual consumers.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The retirement inquiry identifies the item, the actual remaining user and the protection/evidence lost by deletion. That limits F041 participation to an actual submission or reuse obligation and rejects a permanent paperwork programme justified only by a label.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Distinguishing a useful formal artifact or trusted abstraction from infrastructure ceremony.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: Recognition supplies an actual procedural evidential role and can justify retaining a record. The same fact does not prove the artifact's theorem or system function; thus useful assurance communication and unsupported correctness marketing receive different evaluations.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Distinguishing a useful formal artifact or trusted abstraction from infrastructure ceremony.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The actual consumer discriminator identifies which assurance record communicates an objective/configuration/assumption and which extra artifact changes no warranted choice. This preserves legitimate framework evidence while challenging volume or branding as proof.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Inheritance of a claim-evidence relation across component/configuration changes.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The2004 reusable-component example separates inherited scientific support from recognized reuse status. Changed-component acceptance requirements can remain even when some theorem premises survive; unchanged reuse under accepted limits can avoid redundant work. This changes which kind of currentness is being claimed.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Inheritance of a claim-evidence relation across component/configuration changes.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The actual changed-premise analysis identifies which scientific claims and dependencies survive or need renewed evidence, independently of the administrative status. It gives the framework submission a concrete impact argument without assuming that identical bytes or age settle either kind of currentness.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Choosing an adequate evidence path while preserving applicable obligations.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: An optional assurance means is not a universal command to create a certification workflow. Where the specified means is actually selected and applicable, its evidence role can be a real constraint on an otherwise cheap engineering choice. Recognition alone still does not establish adequacy of the scientific discriminator.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Removing, replacing, archiving or keeping a reliability evidence/control duty.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The framework example gives a concrete kind of latent evidence obligation that can survive recent non-use, and a conditional reuse route that avoids gratuitous recertification. The decision distinguishes retiring active work, keeping a record and withdrawing an unsupported scientific claim.

rows.actual_receiving_evidence_role: Removing, replacing, archiving or keeping a reliability evidence/control duty.
rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The native removal criterion makes the actual residual consumer, lost evidence and transition cost explicit before claiming that framework records are obsolete. It does not impose a standing certification consumer when none exists.

source_record.unassigned_complement: All other F041 directions remain UNEXAMINED unless previously assigned. No absence is inferred from an unlocated target framework or from the particular candidate range.
